records.description: Runnable is an independent CI control plane that runs GitHub Actions-compatible workflows without relying on the Actions scheduler or runner infrastructure. records.name: Hirixa

records.name: MouseKit

Mouse Trail follows you while you work. One click switches to drawing mode: shapes, arrows, text, magnifier, spotlight, timer, canvas. Seven profiles change the whole app in one click. Works over Zoom, Meet, PowerPoint. Speaks 15 languages. Everything runs locally. Free version has no watermark. Paid is bought once, works forever.

records.name: FitGate

records.description: FitGate intercepts the moment your AI coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot CLI, Codex, Gemini CLI, Windsurf...) stops to ask "Do you want to proceed?" — and gates that approval behind a 10-second-to-2-minute micro-workout: push-ups, squats, a stretch, a 20-20-20 eye rest. You were about to sit and wait anyway. Now the wait makes you healthier. Free, open source (AGPL-3.0), runs offline forever, no account needed.

records.name: Vistoria.AI

Desenvolvido para tornar o trabalho de campo mais organizado, facilitar a documentação das informações necessárias à elaboração de relatórios técnicos. Software por assinatura para gestão de vistorias profissionais de imóveis e edificações

records.name: CCC

Free for personal use, source on GitHub.

records.name: TheorySprout

records.name: Playlist Finder

records.description: .Playlist Finder connects to your Spotify account and lets you browse all your playlists in one place, with real track counts and search built in. Browsing is free; Search and Rediscover unlock with a one-time $4.99 payment, no subscription.

records.name: Nakxi
records.tagline: AI App Store Optimization Platform for Mobile Apps
records.description: Creating a great app listing shouldn't require five different tools. Nakxi is an AI App Store Optimization Platform that helps you design App Store & Google Play screenshots, generate AI-powered metadata, research keywords, analyze competitors and reviews, optimize visual ASO, localize screenshots and listings, and publish directly to App Store Connect and Google Play—all from one workspace.

records.name: The Super Launcher Extreme
records.tagline: AI-powered scanner for all collectibles.
records.description: App Name: The Super Scanner Ultimate Core Features: AI-powered instant scanning, 70 custom folder designs, and an updateable PDF knowledge library. Supported Items: Trading cards, coins, stamps, paper money, comic books, postcards, magazines, vinyl records, and vintage toys. Benefits: Accurate value tracking, professional-grade cataloging, and seamless organization in one app.

records.name: Money Still
records.tagline: Turn purchases you skip into progress toward your goals
records.description: Money Still helps you make every skipped purchase count. Log spending you avoided or reduced, put it toward illustrated goals, and see progress through calendars, trends and milestones. Add a pause to impulse spending with app cooldown reminders. For iPhone and iPad, with local storage and no account required. Free to download with an optional one-time Pro unlock.

records.name: agent-harness
records.tagline: The missing package manager for MCP servers and AI skills
records.description: Stop managing AI agent assets by hand. agent-harness discovers MCP servers, skills, and rules from trusted sources; pins and mirrors them reproducibly; quarantines risky inputs; then wires everything into Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Zed, Codex and Pi.

records.name: klenua build
records.tagline: Safely manage version & build numbers across projects.
records.description: Tired of hunting version numbers across pubspec.yaml, build.gradle, Info.plist, package.json, tauri.conf.json before every release? klenua build finds them all, shows a diff first, then updates everything at once. 🔍 Auto-detects Flutter, Android, iOS/macOS, Electron, Tauri 📝 Diff preview before any write 🛟 Automatic backups, restore in one click ☁️ Sync config & backups to your klenua account 🚫 Flags dynamic values instead of guessing ⚡ One-shortcut build increments

records.name: Drive Share
records.tagline: Turn any Google Drive folder into a page worth sending.
records.description: Drive Share turns a shared Google Drive folder into a clean page you can send — no Google account, no sign-in, nothing to install for the person who opens it. Photos in a grid, videos playing in place, other files as tiles, download-all as a zip. There's no server and no database: your files stay in Drive and Google serves them, we never see your folders or who opens them. Free for 3 days, then a one-time $19. No subscription.

records.name: Silent core telegram channel products

Doodlyo understands the key message and transforms it into a unique doodle-style social visual with a matching caption, ready to share in seconds. Perfect for founders, marketers, and creators who have something worth saying but don’t want to spend hours designing it.

records.name: DrawDog
records.tagline: Prove a Human Made It, Not a Prompt
records.description: Clients are starting to ask freelancers to prove their work wasn't generated. DrawDog sits in your menu bar and records how your file grew, what apps were in front of you, and whether an AI tool was ever open. It signs and timestamps that record, then gives you one link to send. The client drags your file onto the page to confirm it's the one you certified. It never looks inside your work: no screen recording, no keystrokes, no file names. Three certificates a month, free.

records.name: Stilny | Your AI Stylist
records.tagline: Get dressed in 10 seconds
records.description: Every morning, Stilny picks a complete outfit from your wardrobe. Most people have a wardrobe they never use because they can't remember what they own. This app changes that. Currently in closed beta. Looking for testers before public launch. Accept it or swipe for another. No more "what should I wear?" decision fatigue.

records.name: ZoInvoice
records.tagline: Invoicing that feels effortless.
records.description: Create, send and track invoices in any currency. Flexible taxes, multi-currency, server-rendered PDFs and effortless payments.

records.name: omadesign
records.tagline: Native Linux studio for design, paint, photo & motion
records.description: omadesign is an open-source (MIT) native Linux studio for designers who left macOS — or never had a clean Affinity/Illustrator-shaped seat on Linux. Design, Pixel, Photo, and Motion share one document and layer stack. v0.0.4-alpha. Built to sit down and make work, not babysit Electron.

records.name: Agent Civilizations
records.tagline: An open, verifiable public record of what AI agents do
records.description: Agent Civilizations records events where AI agents coordinate, attack, or form persistent communities, mined continuously from public sources in English, Chinese and Russian. Every entry carries the sources it was judged on, both clocks (when it happened, when the register recorded it), and a hash binding it to the entry before it. Each day is sealed into a Merkle root and anchored in Bitcoin. Nothing is edited or deleted; corrections are entries too. Verify it: npx @agentcivilizations/verify

records.name: BuildBrief

Each prompt auto-fills from the last one, nothing gets retyped. One self-contained HTML file. No account, no software to install.

records.name: EditTextImage
records.tagline: Edit image text while preserving its original style
records.description: Edit text in images with AI — no Photoshop needed. Replace text in screenshots, posters, product images, JPEGs and PNGs while preserving the original font, color, lighting and perspective. Get 1 free credit when you sign up.

records.name: llmaker
records.tagline: Selfhost LLM stacks. Run whole fleets from your terminal
records.description: llmaker is an open source platform for running the complete modern LLM stack on your own infrastructure. Large language models, vector databases, embeddings, caching, observability and a builtin retrieval & agent layer. All provisioned, networked and production shaped from a single command. Build private retrieval augmented chatbots, FAQ assistants and recommendation engines locally. No third-party API keys. No data leaving your machine.

records.name: Tu WhatsApp con IA
records.tagline: Tu WhatsApp con IA: guía paso a paso con n8n
records.description: Guía en PDF de 13 páginas para conectar WhatsApp Business API + n8n + IA (Gemini) y armar tu propio bot de WhatsApp — con los errores reales que te vas a encontrar y cómo resolverlos, no solo la teoría. Pensada para freelancers, agencias y emprendedores que quieren automatizar WhatsApp sin depender de un desarrollador full-time.

records.name: Kubrio Spooky Season

Your kid picks it, makes it with three AI thinking partners and Claire, an AI coach you shape, and finishes it by Sunday. A 9-shot scary movie. A haunted-house hunt the family plays. A field notebook of the creatures of the night. Spooky, never gory: you set the fear dial. $29 a week to make. Playing and watching are free.

records.name: Upvera
records.tagline: The progress network for people who build.

Here, the product itself becomes the social object.

records.name: YTMP3X for Microsoft Edge

records.description: YTMP3X is now available for Microsoft Edge. Open supported public media, choose your MP3 quality and convert directly from the browser. records.name: Callout3D — interactive 3D instructions

Math Rush is designed to make students want to practice regularly rather than treating math as just another school subject.

Allergies filtered automatically. Also includes: a personalized supplement stack, weather-adjusted hydration targets, an auto-built grocery list, and weekly progress tracking. 3 free scans to start.

records.name: goboscript
records.tagline: the Scratch compiler

records.name: RateGuard
records.tagline: Centralized API rate limiting, built for modern services

Deploy it with Docker, manage rules from a web dashboard, and integrate with Node.js or Python using the official SDKs or using APIs.

records.name: LeafLens for Android

records.name: AI Growth Agent

records.name: Zzpkit

Fast, natural, and effortless.

records.description: Most code tools read one repository at a time. Same index, read many ways: PR review that sees cross-repo callers, dependency audit, CycloneDX SBOM, and an MCP server with 18 tools. Self-hosted, docker compose. Your model key, or Ollama locally. AGPL-3.0.

records.name: Talynk
records.tagline: AI-powered career network for smarter hiring and job search

Recruiters get candidate matching, explainable rankings, skill insights and hiring tools to discover stronger candidates faster.

records.name: Port Tools
records.tagline: Know which project owns every localhost port
records.description: Port Tools is a native macOS menu bar app for developers who lose track of localhost services across repos and worktrees. Instead of showing only a port and PID, it maps each listener to its project, branch, app, and service type, and gives web apps stable *.localhost names. Before stopping an eligible service, it rechecks the process identity and refuses when the evidence is weak. It runs locally and is open source.

records.name: Don't Lock My PC
records.tagline: Stop screen locks & sleep during long autonomous AI runs
records.description: Long-running AI agents, model downloads, and automated workflows shouldn't be interrupted by corporate lock screens or sleep timers. Don't Lock My PC keeps your system awake without registry hacks, then auto-powers down when your work is finished.

records.name: MyKanBan — Free Agile Scrum Engine

records.name: Hangman: Shadow Valley

With no timers, no intrusive ads, no subscriptions and no addictive loops, it is designed exclusively to promote focus and anxiety relief.

Runs locally over stdio via npx. MIT licensed, open source.

records.name: Forbidden Words Now

records.description: Forbidden Words Now is a high-energy party game: describe the target word to your teammates without saying any of the "forbidden" words on the card, or the other team steals the point. It comes with a massive, constantly fresh word library across multiple categories, customizable round timers so you control the pace, and a strict privacy-first design — no tracking, no data collection, everything stays on-device. No subscription needed to play.

records.name: DailyRoutine
records.tagline: One app for work, study, fitness and everyday life
records.description: DailyRoutine brings work, study, fitness, and everyday routines into one simple app. Choose the mode that fits your life and manage routines, track progress, and stay organized without juggling multiple apps. For employees, it also combines attendance and salary tracking with useful insights. Built for people who want their daily life in one place.

Warden is designed to make MCP execution safer by default, with a fail-closed approach when the required sandbox cannot be initialized.

records.name: Free Tools Hub

records.description: Free Tools Hub is a collection of 34+ free browser-based tools — no sign-up, no file uploads, no daily limits. Everything runs client-side, so your files and data never leave your device.

records.name: CourtzClub
records.tagline: Celebrate your tennis wins, not just log them

I play amateur tennis, and my results were already logged in the league system, but nobody celebrated them there. CourtzClub tracks sessions, hitting partners, courts played, and gear in one place instead of scattered across texts and memory. It also includes Bump Forecast, our own read on whether your level is trending up, holding, or declining. Not an official rating. Free to start.

records.name: Wanda AI: Voice for Your Agent
records.tagline: Voice for your AI agent — OpenClaw, NanoBot & ZeroClaw.

It supports OpenClaw, NanoBot, ZeroClaw, and compatible gateways, with Live Mode, wake phrases, barge-in, streaming responses, live captions, and local conversation history.

records.name: Mr. Lapkins

records.description: Meet Mr. Lapkins - a cozy, cat-themed daily planner designed to make task management fun and stress-free. Unlike complex, cold productivity tools, Mr. Lapkins turns your to-do list into an engaging habit through light gamification, Pomodoro timers, and cute collectible rewards. Key features: • Visual task calendars with a warm, minimalist UI • Collectible seasonal items & rewards to celebrate every win Perfect for creatives and anyone who wants a gentle, ADHD-friendly approach to daily routines!

records.name: Lovegotchi: Shared Virtual Pet

Care for Mochi together, complete daily actions, build streaks, chat, save memories and journals, unlock achievements, and watch your pet evolve through six stages. Instead of another relationship tracker, Lovegotchi turns staying connected into a playful daily ritual you both share.

records.name: SubDuo
